findings.currentPlan: Omgevingsplan gemeente Harderwijk CVDR696240 remains the address-specific spatial source.
findings.currentPolicy: Beleidsregels splitsen en delen van woningen Harderwijk 2026, CVDR760198, are current from 10-04-2026 and replace the old 2021 splitting policy.
findings.scope: The 2026 policy applies inside the built-up area where the Omgevingsplan itself does not already allow the intended split/share use.
findings.woningsplitsing: Resulting independent dwellings must each have at least 24 m2 use area; the original dwelling must satisfy the current WOZ/tenure eligibility rule; new-build dwellings cannot be split in the first 10 years; Bbl, parking, sound insulation and fire safety apply.
findings.woningdelenKamerverhuur: For multiple-household use, the policy supports up to 3 persons from different households, or defined inwoning/hospita cases, and otherwise imposes Bbl, minimum 12 m2 per resident, bicycle/storage, parking, new-build sound-isolation level, fire-safety and a 50-metre concentration test for higher-intensity cases.
applicationDocuments: for splitting or room rental to 4+ persons: dimensioned existing and proposed floor plans
where relevant a site plan showing parking
for splitting or room rental to 4+ persons: participation report describing process and outcome
description of intended added housing use: sale/rent, price category and income target group
findings.housingRegulationDistinction: Huisvestingsverordening Harderwijk 2026 does not create a separate housing-stock change permit regime; the current 2026 splitting/sharing policy works through the Omgevingswet/BOPA route.
findings.fees: Legesverordening Harderwijk 2026 is current. Exact permit amount is activity-combination dependent; no potentially cross-municipality tariff line is encoded without positive activity match.

remainingAllowedOnly: case-specific extra studies beyond the policy's core requirements
finalResult: PASS - current 2026 splitting/sharing policy and application document matrix positively established.
